_comment: Tier-2 for skfem poisson#3 (catalog-drift correction): to_meshio was removed from the TOP-LEVEL skfem namespace but still exists at skfem.io.meshio.to_meshio. Measured on skfem 12.0.1: hasattr(skfem,'to_meshio') is False with AttributeError "module 'skfem' has no attribute 'to_meshio'"; the io.meshio one resolves and translates cell types correctly (MeshQuad -> 'quad', MeshTri -> 'triangle'); the resulting meshio.Mesh round-trips through .vtu.
